intro_en: You will learn how to call 101, 102 and 103 and describe an emergency clearly to a dispatcher. You will also contrast English 'be about to' with the Mongolian near-future pattern -х гэж байна.
intro_mn: Та 101, 102, 103 дугаарт залгаж, яаралтай байдлаа диспетчерт тодорхой тайлбарлаж сурна. Мөн англи хэлний 'be about to' бүтэц болон монгол хэлний -х гэж байна хэлбэрийг харьцуулна.

vocab.example_mn: Гал команд таван минутын дотор ирлээ.
vocab.example_en: The fire department arrived within five minutes.
The dispatcher took an emergency call.
People gathered at the accident scene.
The dispatcher asked me for the address.
The roof is close to collapsing.
The building is about to collapse.

sentences.mn: Гал гарлаа, гал команд руу залгана уу!
sentences.en: There's a fire, please call the fire department!
alt_mn: Гал гарчихлаа, гал команд руу залгаарай!
alt_en: A fire has broken out, call the fire department!
sentences.mn_latin: Gal garlaa, gal komand ruu zalgana uu!

sentences.mn: Би 103 руу залгаж түргэн тусламж дуудсан.
sentences.en: I called 103 and requested an ambulance.
alt_en: I dialed 103 and called an ambulance.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi 103 ruu zalgaj türgen tuslamj duudsan.

sentences.en: The police arrived quickly at the accident scene.
alt_en: The police got to the scene of the accident quickly.

sentences.en: The building is about to collapse!
alt_en: The building is going to collapse any moment!

sentences.en: The dispatcher asked me for my address.
alt_en: The dispatcher asked me what my address was.

sentences.en: The driver is badly injured and unconscious.
alt_mn: Жолооч хүнд бэртсэн, ухаан алдсан байна.
alt_en: The driver is seriously hurt and unconscious.

sentences.mn: Бид яг одоо гарах гэж байна.
alt_en: We're just about to head out.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid yag odoo garakh gej baina.

sentences.mn: Тайван байж, надад юу болсныг хэлээрэй.
sentences.en: Stay calm and tell me what happened.
alt_en: Please stay calm and tell me what has happened.
sentences.mn_latin: Taivan baij, nadad yuu bolsnyg kheleerei.

sentences.mn: Яаралтай дуудлагад заавал үнэн зөв хаяг хэлэх хэрэгтэй.
sentences.en: In an emergency call you must give an accurate address.
alt_en: You need to give the correct address in an emergency call.
sentences.mn_latin: Yaaraltai duudlagad zaaval ünen zöv khayag khelekh kheregtei.

sentences.mn: Утас тасрах гэж байна, цэнэг дуусч байна.
sentences.en: The phone is about to cut out; the battery is dying.
alt_en: My phone is about to die; the battery is running out.
sentences.mn_latin: Utas tasrakh gej baina, tseneg duusch baina.

sentences.en: When the fire department arrived, the house was about to burn down completely.
sentences.mn_latin: Gal komand irekhed baishin barag shataj duusakh gej bailaa.

alt_en: My neighbor is waiting for an ambulance.
sentences.mn_latin: Khörsh maani türgen tuslamjiig khüleej baina.

grammar.title_en: Being about to: -х гэж байна vs. 'be about to'
grammar.title_mn: Ойрын ирээдүй: 'be about to' ба -х гэж байна
grammar.explain_en: Mongolian expresses something that is just about to happen with the verb stem + -х гэж байна: нурах гэж байна = 'is about to collapse'. For the past, use байлаа/байсан: унах гэж байсан = 'was about to fall'. English uses be + about to + base verb: 'The building is about to collapse.' The form of 'be' agrees with the subject and tense: am, is, are, was, were. Both forms mean the event is imminent. Note that -х гэж байна can also express an intention or plan (Би Солонгос явах гэж байна = 'I'm planning to go to Korea'), while 'be about to' mainly expresses that something will happen very soon.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд удахгүй болох үйлдлийг 'be about to + үйл үгийн анхны хэлбэр' гэж илэрхийлнэ: 'The building is about to collapse' = Барилга нурах гэж байна. Өнгөрсөн цагт 'was/were about to' ашиглана: 'I was about to call.' = Би залгах гэж байсан. Be үйл үгийг хүн, цагт тааруулна: am, is, are, was, were. Монгол хэлний -х гэж байна нь заримдаа санаа, төлөвлөгөөг илэрхийлдэг (Би Солонгос явах гэж байна) бол 'be about to' нь голчлон яг удахгүй болох гэж буйг хэлнэ.

examples.en: The ger is about to catch fire.
I was just about to call.
The bridge is about to collapse, move away!
The ambulance is about to arrive.

fill_blank.translation: The building is about to collapse!
fill_blank.explain_en: The pattern is verb stem + -х гэж байна for an imminent event.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Удахгүй болох үйлдлийг «-х гэж байна» хэлбэрээр илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.explain_en: 'Руу' marks the direction of a call: залгах + руу.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Залгах үйл үгийн чиглэлийг «руу» үгээр заана.

fill_blank.translation: The police arrived at the accident scene.
fill_blank.explain_en: Dative-locative -т shows where they arrived: газарт.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Ирэх үйлдлийн очих газрыг өгөх-орших тийн ялгалын «-д/-т» нөхцөл илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Be about to' дараа нь 'to' болон үйл үгийн анхны хэлбэр орно.

fill_blank.translation: Цагдаа ирэхэд би 102 руу залгах гэж байсан.

fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Ask for' нь ямар нэг зүйл хүсэх, асуух үед хэрэглэгддэг.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Манай байшин шатаж байна! Дээвэр нурах гэж байна.
dialogue.en: Our house is on fire! The roof is about to collapse.
dialogue.mn_latin: Manai baishin shataj baina! Deever nurakh gej baina.

dialogue.speaker: Диспетчер
dialogue.mn: Та хаана байна вэ? Хаягаа хэлнэ үү.
dialogue.en: Where are you? Please give me your address.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ta khaana baina ve? Khayagaa khelne üü.

dialogue.speaker: Диспетчер
dialogue.mn: Дотор хүн үлдсэн үү? Хэн нэгэн гэмтсэн үү?
dialogue.en: Is anyone still inside? Is anyone injured?
dialogue.mn_latin: Dotor khün üldsen üü? Khen negen gemtsen üü?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Аав маань гарсан, гэхдээ утаанд автсан. Түргэн тусламж хэрэгтэй.
dialogue.en: My father got out, but he inhaled smoke. We need an ambulance.
dialogue.mn_latin: Aav maani garsan, gekhdee utaand avtsan. Türgen tuslamj kheregtei.

dialogue.speaker: Диспетчер
dialogue.mn: Гал команд, түргэн тусламж хоёулаа явж байна. Байшингаас холдоорой.
dialogue.en: The fire department and ambulance are both on the way. Move away from the house.
dialogue.mn_latin: Gal komand, türgen tuslamj khoyoulaa yavj baina. Baishingaas kholdooroi.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: За, баярлалаа. Бид гадаа хүлээж байна.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you. We're waiting outside.
dialogue.mn_latin: Za, bayarlalaa. Bid gadaa khüleej baina.

culture_note.en: In Mongolia, 101 is for the fire department, 102 for the police and 103 for ambulance services. Ger district fires are common in winter because of stoves, so giving a precise address, including the khoroo and building number, is essential. Stay calm, speak slowly and follow the dispatcher's instructions.
culture_note.mn: Монголд 101 нь гал команд, 102 нь цагдаа, 103 нь түргэн тусламжийн дугаар юм. Өвлийн улиралд гэр хорооллын зуухнаас болж гал түймэр их гардаг тул хороо, байрны дугаартай хаягаа үнэн зөв хэлэх нь маш чухал. Тайван, удаан ярьж, диспетчерийн зааврыг дагаарай.

review.notes: Mostly good content, but one vocab entry is wrong (бүтэлгүйтэх), there are some small spelling errors, and the grammar note and one alternative are inaccurate.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed vocab glosses, unnatural wording, a mismatched alternative, inconsistent grammar notes, a non-unique blank answer and culture note alignment.

changes.why: The headword should be the verb itself, not a phrase with нурах, to match the gloss.
хүнд means seriously; the gloss left it out.
'About to... right now' is redundant and unnatural.
хэлээч is informal and breaks the polite dispatcher register.
Mongolian says цэнэг дуусах, not батарей дуусах.
'Almost completely burned down' says it already burned, not that it was about to.
The intention claim was inaccurate and didn't match the mn version; the be-agreement point was missing.
'Оролдож байна' (trying) was wrong; this now matches the en version.
Colloquial 'нурах гээд байна' is also acceptable, so the answer was not unique.
Removes the unverified 105 claim, which the mn version lacks, and aligns the en and mn content.
